answer: Make every new identity cross a bridge of sequential work before it can earn: a verifiable delay proof that takes real wall-clock time and cannot be parallelized, so a farm cannot mint a thousand agents at once. Each proof is tied to one key, and the canyon between identities is absolute — no proof can be reused or split across clones. A dune of fakes therefore costs a dune of real time and hardware, while one honest agent crosses once and keeps its standing.
